newsitem.title: USA: Allstate Corp Q3 oper net falls.
newsitem.headline: Allstate Corp Q3 oper net falls.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: Excluding special actions in the 1996 quarter, Q3 income was $509 million or $1.14 a share.
1996 Q3 oper income includes $207 million after-tax charge to strengthen net loss reserves for discontinued lines and coverages, including those related to asbestos and environmental exposures.
1996 Q3 oper income also includes $98 million after-tax assessment to participate in California Earthquake Authority.

1996 Q3 oper income also includes $57 million after-tax benefit due to revision in company's policy for capitalizing deferred acquisition costs to include all forms of agent compensation and expense reimbursement, which vary directly with premium production.
The net impact of these special actions was an after-tax charge of $248 million, or $0.56 a share.
Realized capital gains in Q3 were $79 million after-tax vs $36 million.
Q3 net income was $292 million or $0.65 a share vs $446 million or $1.00 a share.
The combined ratio for the company's core personal lines was 95.2.
